preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= m <= n for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of people n is between 2 and 1000, and the number of steel chains m is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= a_i <= 10**4 for a_i in a) for a in weights)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the weights of all fridges a_i are between 0 and 10^4.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i][0] == -1 or (isinstance(result[i][0], int) and all(isinstance(u, int) and 1 <= u <= n and isinstance(v, int) and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in result[i][1])) for i, (n, m) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the result is either -1 indicating no solution, or a list of m pairs (u, v) where each pair represents a steel chain connecting fridges u and v, with 1 <= u, v <= n and u != v.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i][0] == -1 or len(result[i][1]) == m for i, (n, m) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if there is a solution, the number of steel chains is exactly m.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i][0] == -1 or result[i][0] == sum(a[u-1] + a[v-1] for u, v in result[i][1]) for i, (n, m, a) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if there is a solution, the total cost is the sum of the weights of the fridges connected by each steel chain.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i][0] == -1 or all(len(set(neighbors[u])) == 1 for u in range(1, n+1)) for i, (n, m, a) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if there is a solution, each fridge is private, meaning only its owner can open it.
